description: This PHP class defines a test synchronization service for LDAP integration within the OrangeHRM system, extending LDAPSyncService and managing LDAP test operations and settings.

classes.name: LDAPTestSyncService
classes.description: A service class for testing LDAP synchronization, extending the LDAPSyncService class and managing LDAP test service initialization and configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the LDAPTestSyncService with provided LDAP settings.

methods.name: getLDAPService
methods.description: Returns an LDAPService instance, initializing and binding to LDAPTestService if not already set.

methods.name: getLDAPSetting
methods.description: Returns the LDAP settings associated with this service.
